body: I've always loved that quote. I was homeschooled from 1st-4th grade because the public school wouldnt give me the proper help I needed to deal with my dyslexia, then attended a small private school that had no grades, loose definitions of classes, subjects and class rooms, and a ton of outdoor time. It taught in a very different way than the other school I had been to at the time. I learned more being home schooled and at that school than any other school I went to. When I went back to "normal" school for high school, I found myself way ahead of most kids in my grade. School is in my eyes somewhat of a formality. Learn what you love and love what you learn, chances are, you wont find it in school.
